Instructional Designer (fictional demo role) - Lomda Labs, Haifa

About the role
Lomda Labs builds online courses for companies and schools. We are looking for an Instructional Designer who can turn expert knowledge into clear, engaging e-learning.

What you will do
- Design e-learning modules and self-paced courses from start to finish.
- Write storyboards and learning objectives with subject matter experts.
- Build interactive content and assessments with automatic feedback.
- Publish and maintain courses in our LMS (Moodle).
- Use learner data to improve courses over time.

Requirements
- 2+ years designing learning experiences, in education or in companies.
- Experience building online or self-paced courses.
- Strong understanding of instructional design and assessment design.
- Experience with an LMS such as Moodle.
- Clear writing in Hebrew and English.

Nice to have
- Articulate Storyline or Rise.
- Video editing for short learning videos.
